Retired by ADR-0049 (stage C). The charge forecast — the volume due by each CPT on a process path — is a planning decision and moved to warehouse-planning (its ADR 0023), which takes it as `PUT /workload-forecasts/{site_id}/{path_id}`. This route records nothing, publishes nothing and answers `410 Gone` with the problem type `charge-forecast-moved` for any body; it disappears in stage E. The `Idempotency-Key` header is still checked first, as on every POST.
